title: KVSalienceBench: artifact for Mining Attention Dynamics: Auditing KV-Saliency Prediction in LLMs
description: Reproducibility artifact for the accepted D2AI at IEEE ICDM 2026 paper DM2158. Includes version-2 and historical experiment records, analysis and validation code, the pinned MIT-licensed simulator source bundle, tests, LaTeX and PDF, editable draw.io diagram source, Python chart sources and an English presentation. Source input corpora, model weights, raw attention traces and internal review history are excluded. Masked-loop answer-quality findings do not imply production serving efficiency. This metadata file prepares a later author-managed Zenodo deposit; it is not evidence that a DOI has been issued.
